description: Brings a picture, clip or song into a video from a public link (a fal or Higgsfield output) or from a file on this computer (file, then staging_key), and returns its asset_id for put_overlay, add_clip or set_audio. Clips up to 100 MiB, pictures and songs up to 32 MiB. Cost: Free: no credits.

file.description: Or a file on this computer (two calls).

name.description: A file name to keep it under.

operation_id.description: A retry with the same id runs once.

url.description: A public https link to a picture, clip or song (PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, M4A).

name: import_media

outputSchema.description: Clypmint import_media result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Bring in a file
